verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Stripe publishes detailed API reference pages for Issuing endpoints (cards, cardholders, etc.) and markdown-accessible docs, but nothing explicitly confirms an interactive, runnable-example experience (e.g., live code sandboxes or in-browser request execution) — the OpenAPI spec probe even returned 404s. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or demonstration of runnable/interactive code snippets, live API console, or sandboxed example execution within the reference pages.
